title: I'm but a Stranger Here
description: I'm but a Stranger Here in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 4 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Thomas Rawson Taylor, first published in 1836. The tune, ST. EDMUND (SULLIVAN), is by Arthur Seymour Sullivan (1872). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: I'm but a stran-ger here, Heav'n is my home; Earth is a des-ert drear, Heav'n is my home. Dan-ger and sor-row stand round me on ev-ery hand; Heav'n is my fa-ther-land,_ Heav'n is my home.

lines: I shall reach home at last,
There are the good and blest,
those I loved most and best;
There, too, I soon shall rest,
there at my Lord's right hand.
